name: Sponge
overview: The Scriptures present the sponge as a simple yet significant instrument used during the crucifixion of Christ, specifically to offer Him vinegar to drink. In Matthew 27:48 and Mark 15:36, the sponge is filled with vinegar and placed on a reed, symbolizing a moment of both physical suffering and fulfillment of prophecy. John 19:29 adds detail by noting the sponge was placed on hyssop, linking this act to Old Testament purification imagery. These verses collectively highlight the sponge's role in the Passion narrative, underscoring the reality of Christ's suffering and the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan.
